proposals.title: STOCKHOLDER PROPOSAL REGARDING PAY EQUITY REPORT
proposals.proponent: Pax World Mutual Funds, along with co-sponsor the Comptroller of the City of New York
proposals.topic_summary: Requests Oracle prepare a report by April 2020 identifying whether a gender pay gap exists among its employees and outlining steps to reduce it.
proposals.evidence: the Board unanimously recommends a vote AGAINST adoption of Proposal No. 4.

proposals.title: STOCKHOLDER PROPOSAL REGARDING INDEPENDENT BOARD CHAIR
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a policy requiring the Chairman of the Board to be an independent member of the Board whenever possible, with phase-in allowed.
proposals.evidence: the Board unanimously recommends a vote AGAINST adoption of Proposal No. 5.
